verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents Rico, an AI assistant that answers plain-language questions about your subscription data (e.g. "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?") with direct, data-driven answers instead of you digging through charts. That covers the core of AI-generated insights from your own data. The AI paywall generation feature is not data-driven insight, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations (as opposed to answers to questions), explicit confirmation that Rico runs inside the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
